summary: OceanPal Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 27, 2026, announcing a legal name change to SVRN, Inc., effective upon filing an amendment to its Amended and Restated Articles of Incorporation with the Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations. The filing includes the Articles of Amendment (Exhibit 3.1) and a press release (Exhibit 99.1). The board and shareholders authorized the change. No financial terms, transactions, or strategic actions are involved. This is a routine corporate name change, not a special situation, and is incorporated by reference into existing F-3 shelf registration statements.
